title_zh: 封箱前再检查易碎品包装

scenario.label_zh: 易碎包裹的封箱前检查
scenario.goal_zh: 指出玻璃破碎风险并约定拍照检查后封箱

context_zh: 商店助手 Kira 与包装员 Mo 准备寄出一个玻璃灯罩。
author: author-phase12-b

sentences.speaker: Kira
sentences.text: Is this lampshade ready for shipping? The customer asked for a packing photo.

sentences.speaker: Mo
sentences.text: Almost. I haven’t closed the box yet.

sentences.speaker: Kira
sentences.text: The glass could shatter if it hits the side. There’s an empty space beside the rim.

sentences.speaker: Mo
sentences.text: I’ll fill that space and take the photo. Can you check it before I seal the box?

sentences.speaker: Kira
sentences.text: Yes. Send me the photo first, and I’ll come over to look at the packing.

sentences.speaker: Mo
sentences.text: All right. I’ll leave the box open until you’ve checked it.
